name: shader-warp-deep-sea
title: Shader Warp Deep Sea

name: shader-warp-marble
title: Shader Warp Marble
desc: Cream and charcoal marble veins swirling together.

name: shader-warp-ocean

desc: Glossy aqua currents traced with dark ink edges.

name: shader-warp-rose-gold
title: Shader Warp Rose Gold

name: shader-warp-silk
title: Shader Warp Silk
desc: Violet and pink liquid silk folding in slow waves.

name: shader-warp-storm
title: Shader Warp Storm
desc: Deep violet and lavender storm of marbled fluid.

name: shader-warp-sunset
title: Shader Warp Sunset
desc: Marbled coral, peach and wine flowing like warm liquid.

name: shader-water
title: Shader Water
desc: Caustic water-surface ripples with subtle refraction.

name: shader-weave
title: Shader Weave
desc: A woven substrate of warp and weft threads crossing on a domain-warped grid, with a travelling sheen.

name: shadow-sweep-text
title: Shadow Sweep Text
desc: A line rises up and left while one dense dark shadow uncovers it and a second shadow sweeps back across it for the exit.

name: shape-cut
title: Shape Cut
desc: A circle, square or pill grows from the text and cuts to the next scene with the logo.

name: shape-morph-o
title: Shape Morph O
desc: A shape morphs into the O of the wordmark beside the R mark.

name: shape-pack
title: Shape Pack
desc: Tiles pack together into a poster grid, one block locking a 3.2x stat.

name: shards-to-grid
title: Shards to Grid
desc: Shards of images snap into a media grid with a "Every frame, written in code" label.

name: share-donut
title: Share Donut
desc: A gradient donut sweeps around to 38% with competitor shares labeled outside.

name: shared-axis-y
title: Shared Axis Y
desc: Per-word hard-cut transition with staircase timing for sharp editorial swaps.

name: shared-axis-z
title: Shared Axis Z
desc: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.

name: shed-weight
title: Shed Weight
desc: 'Sharp at any size.' repeats at growing sizes, weight adjusting per size, with pt labels.

name: sheen-slide-in
title: Sheen Slide In
desc: A title glides in from the right with an exponential settle and a slow final creep to center, while a gradient sheen sweeps once through the glyphs.

name: sheet
title: UI Sheet
desc: A side panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and right-edge slide-in are keyframed presets, with a close button and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

name: sheet-formula
title: Sheet Formula
desc: A spreadsheet formula fills a column and drops a bar chart on top.

name: shimmer-sweep
title: Shimmer Sweep
desc: Light shine sweeps across muted text via background-clip:text.

name: short-slide-down
title: Short Slide Down
desc: Each new word drops in from above into its own line and pushes the stack downward until a centered three-line composition locks in place.

name: short-slide-right
title: Short Slide Right
desc: The whole phrase glides in from the left as one compact move while words reveal in sequence through opacity.

name: shot-answers
title: Shot Answers
desc: A screenshot tile slides beside "Your launch video is just another pull request.".

name: shot-clock
title: Shot Clock
desc: A shot clock counts down to 0.0 in red, then 'SHIPPED' lands 'at the buzzer'.

name: signal-resolve
title: Signal Resolve
desc: Noisy scope traces resolve to a clean line and the logo with Less noise. More signal.

name: signup-flow
title: UI Signup Flow
desc: A signup card composition: a real shadcn-style card (header, labeled Full Name / Email / Password / Confirm fields, primary + Google-outline buttons, sign-in footer) whose cursor fills each field top-to-bottom, then clicks Create account (hover → press → loading → success) as a success toast slides in. A pure orchestrator — every channel comes from a composed primitive's transition hook.

name: simulated-cursor
title: Simulated Cursor
desc: Animated mouse cursor moving between waypoints with click ripple feedback.

name: single-stroke
title: Single Stroke
desc: A giant 27 drawn in single strokes sits beside a coral 'Mar' panel and a demo-day line.

name: skeleton
title: UI Skeleton
desc: A skeleton→content crossfade whose loading/loaded state is a pure function of the timeline. The Skeleton renderer is pure (reads no frame); only the composed SkeletonBlock shimmer reads it. SkeletonStyle opacities sum to 1 so the box never dims; real children sit in normal flow and the placeholder (a lines/card layout or a custom node) is an absolute overlay.

name: skeleton-block
title: UI Skeleton Block
desc: A shimmer placeholder block — a motion atom (spinner pattern). A directional highlight gradient sweeps across deterministically from useCurrentFrame() and loops seamlessly. Configurable width/height/radius/speed and base/highlight colors.

name: slash-wipe
title: Slash Wipe
desc: A gradient slash wipes across and reveals a large title, '/transitions', with a one-line sub.

name: slide-doors
title: Slide Doors
desc: Two panels slide apart like doors to reveal 'Arriving in your repo.' with an accent word.

name: slide-swap
title: Slide Swap
desc: A scene sequencer where the outgoing content is shoved off on an accelerating curve and the next springs in from the opposite edge, on one canvas, with no overlap.

name: slider
title: UI Slider
desc: A slider whose fill is a numeric value channel plus a thumb idle/hover/press channel (dual-channel value-channel deviation). The Slider renderer is pure (clamped 0–100 value, thumb scale, grab-ring opacity); useSliderTransition reads the frame and eases both channels — value as a numeric lerp, the thumb visual from its state presets. Muted track + primary range + bordered thumb with a derived grab

name: slim-count
title: Slim Count
desc: A slim outlined zero counts down beside a condensed line, 'Keyframes left to set by hand'.

name: slit-reveal
title: Slit Reveal
desc: A point of light draws a hairline that opens onto a product scene, with a glow ring below.

name: slit-scan
title: Slit Scan
desc: A word is slit-scanned into view through fluted slices, with a speed stat in the caption.

name: slope-chart
title: Slope Chart
desc: A slope chart draws before/after lines, the hero line rising to a 6.8x stat.

name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot Machine Roll
desc: Vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

name: smash-count
title: Smash Count
desc: A giant red 64 smash-cuts up from zero beside a small caption.

name: smoke-dissolve
title: Smoke Dissolve
desc: A smoke-ring shader transition that expands the ring outward to reveal the next scene.

name: snap-click
title: Snap Click
desc: The wordmark snaps together at a seam with a click, settling over a subtle caption.

name: social-scheduler
title: Social Scheduler
desc: A weekly post queue where a post is scheduled and a toast confirms.

name: soft-blur-in
title: Soft Blur In
desc: Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion. Apple's signature hero-title reveal.

name: sold-out
title: Sold Out
desc: A stock counter races to zero, then a tilted chrome-gradient 'SOLD OUT' band slams across.

name: sparkline-thread
title: Sparkline Thread
desc: A glowing sparkline climbs to a point while +212% counts up beside it.

name: spec-sheet
title: Spec Sheet
desc: A tech spec table with hairline rows reveals values like 4K, 60 fps and 1 command.

name: speed-lines
title: Speed Lines
desc: Parallel streaks trail an element as it flies in at its real speed, the element stretching with that speed and landing with a squash and a small bounce as the streaks die, or radial lines rush in from the frame edges and snap onto one point for a manga-style impact frame.

name: speed-ramp-word
title: Speed Ramp Word
desc: Time slows on the key word as it warms to a gradient, with a timecode HUD.

name: speed-trap
title: Speed Trap
desc: A speed readout locks on 348 km/h over a segmented bar with last year's marker and delta.

name: speedrun-timer
title: Speedrun Timer
desc: A speedrun split table fills row by row and ends on a gold 'WORLD RECORD' time.

name: spell-out
title: Spell Out
desc: "remocn" spells out in big lowercase letters with "Say it once. Remember it." beneath.

name: spine-turn
title: Spine Turn
desc: Vertical titles turn like book spines, handing off to a large accent 'Wrap-up'.

name: spinner
title: UI Spinner
desc: A deterministic spinning arc that loops on the Remotion frame — a pure motion atom with no state.

name: split-flash
title: Split Flash
desc: A lap-time clock freezes on its final value, flashing a purple bar and a minus delta.

name: split-match
title: Split Match
desc: Split-flap reels lock onto each word in turn, the last one becoming the big logo.

name: split-word
title: Split Word
desc: A huge word splits open and a second word slides into the gap with a gradient band.

name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
desc: A soft spotlight cone searches the dark stage, overshoots, and lands on the logo before the house lights lift.

name: spotlight-text
title: Spotlight Text
desc: A spotlight travels across a dark headline, 'Launch videos, in code.', with a mono eyebrow.

name: spring-bars
title: Spring Bars
desc: Bars spring up with overshoot, one gradient bar highlighted under a 3.4x stat.

name: spring-scale-in
title: Spring Scale In
desc: Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a physical spring settling into place.

name: spring-settle
title: Spring Settle
desc: A scene sequencer where the outgoing scene shrinks away as one group, the stage holds empty for a beat, and the next scene's items land staggered from above-1 scale.

name: squeeze-in
title: Squeeze In
desc: Characters appear one by one on a tight stagger; when the last one lands, every letter gap compresses as one and the word squeezes together.

name: squeeze-out
title: Squeeze Out
desc: Condensed text squeezes out of the frame line by line, ending 'Freshly pressed frames.'.

name: squiggle
title: Squiggle
desc: A flat line draws itself along a straight course as a traveling wave whose crests swim forward and calm down as the head runs out, in wave, zigzag, loop or coil shapes, then erases toward its end point.

name: squircle-wave
title: Squircle Wave
desc: A wave of squircle cells sweeps across a dot grid and leaves the R mark behind.

name: stack-letters
title: Stack Letters
desc: Letters tumble and stack into place to spell a caps word over a warm gradient.

name: stacked-shift
title: Stacked Shift
desc: A stacked share bar shifts over the years until the logo series reaches 52%.

name: stage
title: Stage
desc: Place a screenshot, recording, or long page on a perspective studio plane and direct an integrated camera across it with timeline keyframes.

name: staggered-fade-up
title: Staggered Fade Up
desc: Words fade in and slide up one after another with a configurable delay.

name: stat-inline
title: Stat Inline
desc: A key number inside a sentence is highlighted: 'Builders shipped 12,480 launch videos this year.'.

name: stat-rail
title: Stat Rail
desc: A mint "4 minutes from install to first render" stat sits beside a headline over scenery.

name: stat-sequence
title: Stat Sequence
desc: Three large stats count up in a row: 10,000+, 99.9% and 4.9.

name: status-page
title: Status Page
desc: A status page with uptime strips on which the cursor hovers an incident bar.
